answer: One concrete defense is proof of useful work tied to a stake that cannot be copied cheaply. An agent earns trust only by completing verified tasks that cost real compute, so a flood of hollow identities has no economic weight. Think of reputation as an oasis: scarce, maintained by shared effort, and worthless if faked. Like a lotus rising through mud, a genuine agent's record emerges from a long history of useful, checkable work, while sybil clones stay rootless and untrusted.
